observations: Photo 0-3 show a pink and white compact handheld iron with a coiled fabric-covered cord.
Text on body reads 'Russell Hobbs', 'LIGHT AND EASY', and 'COLOUR PERFORMA SOLEPLATE' (photos 0,1,2,3).
Soleplate (photo 2,3) shows standard steam vent holes typical of a domestic steam iron, not an industrial press.
Background shows a workshop/repair stall setting with other appliances (blender, another iron) - suggests a used-goods dealer.
No photo shows the iron plugged in, powered on, or producing steam.
No close-up of the power cord plug, rating label, or water fill cap.

claims.claim: Very strong steaming iron tokumbo industrial machine
claims.evidence: Photos 0-3 show a small handheld domestic steam iron with standard soleplate design, not an industrial steam press or heavy-duty machine.
No photo or clip shows the iron powered on, heating, or producing steam.

risks.risk: Heating element or thermostat may be faulty despite 'tested okay' claim.
risks.proof: Short video of the iron plugged in, heating indicator light on, and steam being emitted.

risks.risk: Power cord or plug could be damaged/frayed, posing a safety risk.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the plug and full cord length, especially near the base.

risks.risk: Water tank or spray mechanism (if steam model) may leak or be missing parts like the fill cap.
risks.proof: Photo of the water fill opening and tank lid, plus a spray-function demo.

risks.risk: Soleplate may be scratched, pitted, or have residue affecting fabric contact, not clearly visible due to pink coating glare.
risks.proof: Well-lit, close-up photo of the soleplate under natural light.

proof_requests: Video of the iron plugged in, heating, and producing steam.
Close-up of the power plug and full cord condition.
Close-up of the rating label/model number sticker on the base.
Photo of the water fill cap and tank interior.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Russell Hobbs domestic steam iron, but the seller's 'industrial machine' and 'tested okay' claims are unsupported by any functional proof, so it must be priced at worst case as an untested used household iron.
